## Rule

Input contains a large block motif made from repeated solid-color squares and a separate small numeric cursor patch. The task output is the cursor patch masked by the large motif occupancy: keep cursor digits where the corresponding motif cell exists, emit 0 elsewhere. Visible + arc-gen outputs are 3x3 or 4x4 one-hot tiles; the previous live graph padded the tile to 30x30, but decoded task semantics do not require the trailing zero/background pad.

## Algorithm sketch

Current live ONNX computes a non-background mask (`1 - channel0`), detects solid 3x3/4x4/5x5 blocks by convolution, locates the large motif and cursor, extracts the small cursor, applies motif occupancy, then pads the 4x4 one-hot tile to 30x30.

The selected v2 shrink preserves that live dataflow but compresses row-only spatial masks: `v13`/`v15`/`v18`/`v20` are top/bottom row masks with columns all equal, so they can be stored as `[1,1,H,1]` broadcast masks instead of `[1,1,H,W]`. It also keeps the prior valid `v17` scalar-one replacement for the 5x5 top-half mask, removes the final Pad so the graph returns the 1x10x4x4 tile directly, and removes the stale `v1152` value_info so the scorer no longer counts that intermediate.

## Don't-do log

- Do not resubmit `task170_v2_row_masks_no_final_pad` unchanged; it was public-negative at 5722.92 vs 5736.60 (-13.68).
- Treat the no-final-Pad/direct-4x4-output assumption as suspect for hidden scoring despite local decode-equivalence; future repairs should preserve the competition-expected padded output shape unless stronger evidence proves otherwise.
- Do not rely on generic ONNX optimization for this graph; prior safe optimizer and onnxsim made no score improvement.
- Do not cast the final tail/output to uint8 or fp16; prior probes preserved decoded outputs but increased official score cost.
- Do not scalar-replace `v13`, `v18`, or `v20`; prior full scalar replacements failed. Their safe compression is row-broadcast `[1,1,H,1]`, not scalar.
- Do not zero or collapse the 5x5 detector path; visible/live verification dropped to 186/266 and loses required 5x5 motif cases.
- Do not replace the three solid-block Conv detectors with naive AveragePool thresholding; the 2026-05-23 probe saved only ~50 params and diverged 0/266 vs LIVE because the detector equality semantics changed.
- Cursor color-index before expansion remains blocked: any Slice-based read still materializes `cursor_patch F32[1,10,4,4]=640B`; `ArgMax(cursor_patch)` adds more cost.
- Keep both k=3 and k=4 AveragePool cursor-column branches. k=3-only and leftmost-nonzero probes failed visible/AB because background cursor columns can be empty in `col_nonmotif`.
- Do not use Equal-tail output, QLinearConv output, F16 projection vectors, or nonmotif_w elimination; each prices above the current small one-hot + Pad / F32 projection path.
- Do not use free-output/static Einsum to remove `cursor_patch`; cursor row/column is runtime and the source remap is not static.
- Preserve concrete value_info when editing descendants of the 2568/2535 graph. Re-inference alone creates `unk__N` dynamic Slice dims and scorer memory=None.
